summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of a base prospectus supplement dated 5 May 2026, supplementing its base prospectus dated 30 March 2026, under its debt issuance programme. The filing is a routine capital markets update notifying investors of the availability of the supplement, which updates terms for potential future note offerings. No specific transaction, terms, price, premium, or recommendation is provided; it is merely a regulatory disclosure for programme maintenance. This is not a special situation event—it is a standard prospectus filing.
